subject: Vulnerability Closure Ledger: Snapshot & Proof-of-Fix Bundle
messages:
From: Pedro Álvarez <security@acme-pay.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Chen <lina.chen@acme-pay.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: consolidated closure evidence for recent critical CVEs

Michael,

Thanks again for the call earlier — Acme's audit team has one remaining ask before we close the vulnerability thread for our SOC 2 scope. We need a compact, verifiable "closure ledger" for the set of critical/high CVEs listed below that includes:

- the scan snapshot (tool + timestamp + findings)
- triage owner assignment and remediation SLA met/dates
- patch/hotfix identifiers (commit hashes, package versions)
- where applicable, rollback notes and compensating controls

CVEs: CVE-2027-1122, CVE-2027-1189, CVE-2027-1307

Can you provide a single bundle (CSV + scan JSON + short narrative) we can attach to the audit ticket? Preferably with links to the patch commits or internal PRs and a contact for any follow-up. If you can include per-CVE acceptance timestamps, that will shorten our review.

Attachments: none (we expect the pack from your side).

Pedro
Security Programs — Acme Payments

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Pedro Álvarez <security@acme-pay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated closure evidence for recent critical CVEs

On Sun, May 23, 2027 at 9:12 AM Pedro Álvarez <security@acme-pay.com> wrote:
> Michael,
>
> Thanks again for the call earlier — Acme's audit team has one remaining ask before we close the vulnerability thread for our SOC 2 scope. We need a compact, verifiable "closure ledger" for the set of critical/high CVEs listed below that includes: ...

Hi Pedro — attaching the bundle per your checklist. Short summary below and the artifacts are in the CSV/JSON files.

What we included:
- fix-ledger-20270523.csv: per-CVE rows with owner, SLA target, remediation date, patch ID (where applicable), verification check (scan id)
- scan-report-20270522.json: raw scanner output (tool: TracerScan v3.4), timestamped, with baseline fingerprints
- hotfix-ids-20270522.txt: plain list of commit SHAs and package versions (internal PR links redwood-infra/patches#452, #455)

Notes:
- CVE-2027-1122: patched in package @redwood/runtime v2.1.3, hotfix PR #452, remediation verified by re-scan on 2027-05-22 03:41:12Z
- CVE-2027-1189: mitigated via configuration change (WAF rule 7f3d) and scheduled package update in v2.2.0; compensating control documented in the CSV
- CVE-2027-1307: backported hotfix applied to legacy branch; rollback window closed 2027-05-20

If the auditor needs signed attestation, we can route a short one-page sign-off from our security PO.

I'll leave Kimberly on copy to confirm the verification items for audit.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
Attachments: fix-ledger-20270523.csv (CSV), scan-report-20270522.json (JSON), hotfix-ids-20270522.txt (text)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Pedro Álvarez <security@acme-pay.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-26T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated closure evidence for recent critical CVEs

Michael — good bundle, thanks for assembling. A couple of validation notes for the audit packet (added to the CSV under the 'validator_notes' column):

- Verified scan provenance: TracerScan v3.4 results include a scan_id (ts-20270522-8812); that id maps to our immutable scan archive S3 path and a short SHA in the JSON.
- SLA check: all three CVEs were triaged within 48 hours of discovery and assigned to named owners; remediation ETA vs actual is recorded.
- PRs referenced in hotfix-ids-20270522.txt include CI run IDs; we keep the CI artifact links behind our internal CI system (provided link in related_links).

Pete from Audit may ask for a DocuSign attestation for the remediation acceptance — happy to produce a signed one-page attestation if needed. I also uploaded a checksum file to the Drive folder for the CSV/JSON artifacts.

Kimberly Park
Director, Platform Security — Redwood Inference

From: Pedro Álvarez <security@acme-pay.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Lina Chen <lina.chen@acme-pay.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated closure evidence for recent critical CVEs

Thanks Michael and Kimberly — received and reviewed the bundle. The ledger and scan snapshot look sufficient for our SOC 2 upload. A few follow-ups:

- Can you send the short SHA/checksum file for the JSON (we saw the Drive link but need the checksum pasted into the audit ticket)?
- If you can provide a one-page attestation PDF (DocuSign or signed PDF) that references the ledger filename, that would close the loop for the auditor.

If you can deliver those two items by EOD Friday, we'll mark the CVE items as CLOSED in our audit tracker and send a confirmation.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Pedro Álvarez
Security Programs — Acme Payments
